text:
Predicates:
JapaneseGameCompany(x) ::: x is a Japanese game company.
Game(x) ::: x is a game.
Top10(x) ::: x is in the Top 10 list.
Sell(x, y) ::: x sells y copies.
MadeBy(x, y) ::: x is made by y.
LegendOfZelda ::: the Legend of Zelda.
FIFA22 ::: FIFA 22.
Premises:
JapaneseGameCompany(company) ∧ Game(theLegendOfZelda) ∧ MadeBy(theLegendOfZelda, company) ::: A Japanese game company created the game the Legend of Zelda.
∀x (Top10(x) → ∃y (JapaneseGameCompany(y) ∧ MadeBy(x, y))) ::: All games in the Top 10 list are made by Japanese game companies.
Sell(theLegendOfZelda, oneMillion) → Top10(theLegendOfZelda) ::: If a game sells more than one million copies, then it will be selected into the Top 10 list.
Sell(theLegendOfZelda, oneMillion) ::: The Legend of Zelda sold more than one million copies.
Conclusion:
MadeBy(FIFA22, company) ::: FIFA 22 is made by a Japanese video game company.
